spans.s:
mfn. (-ण्डः-ण्डी-ण्डं)
1 Drunk, intoxicated.
2 Fond of, addicted to, (as liquor.)
f. (-ण्डी)
1 Long-pepper.
2 Another sort, (Piper chavya.)
E.
शुण्डा spirituous liquor, अण् aff.

m. (-कः)
A distiller and vender of spirituous liquors.
f. (-की)
A female keeper of a tavern or dram shop.
E.
शुण्डा spirits, ठञ् aff.

mfn. (-रः-रा-रं)
1 Proud, haughty.
2 Elevated, looking upwards; more properly, शौडीर, and शौटीर as above.
